name: print-social-bede-agency-posts-duotone-cutouts-and-pink-cyan-triangles
title: BEDE design agency posts with black-and-white photo cutouts, duotone triangle panels in pink and cyan
whatItIs: A dark navy square cover and four smaller posts for 'BEDE': a headline 'We Have the Best Designers in the World' in cyan and pink, greyscale photos of people in coats cropped against pink and cyan triangular colour-block panels, small headlines and vertical rotated taglines, closing with a pink-to-cyan gradient footer bar.
whatItMeans: Bold and confident; sharp triangle colour blocks against greyscale photos feel like a design agency showing off its own craft.
techniques: Crop photos against angular duotone colour-block panels.
Rotate a short tagline vertically along a panel edge.
Close a set with a gradient footer bar tying the palette together.

vocabulary.definition: A flat colour-block shape used to frame or crop a photo.
A colour-fading bar closing a layout.
